summary: Frontend-only review of the new SmartBack system (useSmartBack hook + SmartBackButton component) and its integration on FormationDetail.tsx + TextBookDetail.tsx. Code review PASS on all 4 files. End-to-end Playwright validation was PARTIAL because the path 'Administration → Formations tab → click formation' described in the request does NOT match the current Administration page UX in this app: Administration has only 3 tabs (Gestion des utilisateurs / Dossiers administratifs / Gestion des cartes etudiantes) — there is no 'Formations' tab. The querystring ?tab=formations is silently ignored, the page falls back to 'Gestion des utilisateurs'. Formations are reached via the Pédagogie sidebar entry (/formations route) instead. As a consequence, the Administration→FormationDetail entry-point flow described in the user statement could not be reproduced as written. Code-level inspection confirms the implementation is correct: (1) hook uses `location.key !== 'default' && window.history.length > 1` → navigate(-1), else navigate(fallback) — exact spec; (2) component default label is 'Retour'; (3) FormationDetail reads `from` query param and computes fallbackPath = (admin && from==='administration') ? '/administration?tab=formations' : '/formations' — so when Administration eventually exposes a 'Formations' tab, deep-link fallback will work. All 4 required data-testid are present and unique: formation-detail-back (line 115), formation-error-back (line 100), textbook-detail-back (line 406), textbook-not-found-back (line 396). Label is hard-coded to 'Retour' via SmartBackButton default.

integration_issues.issue: Request says 'Login admin → Administration sidebar → onglet Formations → cliquer sur une formation'. But Administration page exposes only 3 tabs: Gestion des utilisateurs, Dossiers administratifs, Gestion des cartes etudiantes. There is no Formations tab here. Navigating to /administration?tab=formations falls back to 'Gestion des utilisateurs' (querystring is ignored). Formations are listed via /formations (Pédagogie sidebar). So the user's described entry-point flow cannot be reproduced as-is — either (a) the user meant Pédagogie → Formations (in which case the smart-back system already works correctly via history), or (b) Administration is intended to expose a Formations tab and the wiring is missing.

action_items: Clarify the Administration→Formations entry-point: either (a) add a 'Formations' tab to the Administration page (matching the user's mental model 'Gestion des formations dans Administration'), or (b) update the user-facing description / agent-to-agent context to reflect that Formations live under Pédagogie. Until this is decided, the FormationDetail fallback `/administration?tab=formations` may navigate to a tab that doesn't render the Formations list.

Manual end-to-end retest by main agent (or testing agent in next iter) using the actual Pédagogie → Formations → click formation flow (and a second flow from Dashboard if a formation card is clickable there) — the SmartBack code itself is correct and should behave as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: useSmartBack.ts (35 lines): clean, single-purpose, well-commented. Logic: hasHistory = location.key !== 'default' && window.history.length > 1. ✓ Matches spec. Memoised via useCallback with correct deps. No issue.
SmartBackButton.tsx (49 lines): tiny, well-typed, defaults label='Retour' & variant='ghost' & fallback='/' & testId='smart-back-button'. ✓

FormationDetail.tsx: import SmartBackButton (line 17). Two usages: error state (line 100, testId='formation-error-back', variant='default') and main header (line 111, testId='formation-detail-back', variant='ghost'). fallbackPath logic (lines 81-83): `(userRole === 'Admin' || 'AdminPrincipal') && from === 'administration' ? '/administration?tab=formations' : '/formations'`. CAVEAT: in this app there is no 'Formations' tab on Administration (see integration issue) — the fallback URL would land back on 'Gestion des utilisateurs'. Recommend either updating the fallback to '/formations' for all roles OR adding the missing tab.

FormationDetail.tsx line 41: `const from = searchParams.get('from') || 'formations'` — the default value 'formations' is used by computing fallbackPath when the page is opened via a direct URL with no `from` param. With default='formations', admin role → fallback resolves to '/formations' (NOT '/administration?tab=formations'). That is the safer default and matches the integration-issue mitigation above. ✓

FormationDetail.tsx line 29-30: still keeps `useNavigate` and `searchParams` imports even though the back navigation is fully delegated to SmartBackButton. `navigate` is still used (line 164 cahier-de-texte) so OK; `searchParams` is used for `from`. No dead imports.

TextBookDetail.tsx: import SmartBackButton (line 21). Two usages: textbook-not-found-back (line 396, variant='outline') and textbook-detail-back (line 406, variant='outline'). The legacy getBackNavigation() helper (lines 377-388) is still computed and its `path` is fed as fallback — both paths simply 'Retour'. Recommend deleting the now-unused `label` field from the returned object (line 381 + line 386) since SmartBackButton hard-codes the label. Minor.
All 4 required data-testid (formation-detail-back, formation-error-back, textbook-detail-back, textbook-not-found-back) are unique in the codebase grep — no clashes. ✓

Setstate-only 'Retour' buttons in Notes/Messagerie/SupportPage/EspaceTravail/Formations are correctly LEFT untouched (they don't navigate, they close a sub-state) — matches the agent_to_agent_context_note. ✓

Edge case to consider for next iter: the hook uses `window.history.length > 1`. After a hard refresh on /formations/:id, browsers may report history.length > 1 even though there is no real previous page (because the browser entry from the address bar counts). That is precisely why the additional `location.key !== 'default'` guard is in place — react-router only stamps non-default keys on programmatic navigations, so on a fresh load the key IS 'default' and we correctly fall back. The implementation is correct. ✓
Pre-existing & ignored per request: Edge Function compute-bulletin CORS/404. No regression introduced by this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: Code review 100% — all 4 testids present, labels correct, hook logic matches spec. End-to-end UI validation only ~30% completed because the requested 'Administration → Formations tab' entry-point does not exist in this app's UX (see integration_issues).

context_for_next_testing_agent: When retesting the SmartBack flow, do NOT use Administration → Formations tab (that tab does not exist in this app — only Gestion des utilisateurs / Dossiers administratifs / Gestion des cartes etudiantes). Use these flows instead: (A) Pédagogie sidebar → click '/formations' submenu → click a formation card → press 'Retour' → expect /formations; (B) From a Dashboard formation card if available → click → 'Retour' → expect /dashboard; (C) Direct URL load /formations/:id → 'Retour' → expect /formations (admin fallback because from='formations' default at line 41). For TextBookDetail, navigate from FormationDetail header button 'Cahier de texte' (line 164) which appends ?from=formations&formationId=... → Retour should navigate back to FormationDetail via history. The login route is /auth (not /login). The 4 required data-testid are confirmed unique and present in source. Code review PASSES; the failing entry-point in the request is a mismatch with the live app UX, not a bug in SmartBack itself.
rca of the issue: Not a bug. The user's described path 'Administration → Formations tab' assumes a tab that doesn't exist in the current Administration page. Either the live app needs a Formations tab added to Administration (matching the user's mental model expressed in the original problem statement quote 'Gestion des formations'), or the user actually meant the Pédagogie → Formations route — which already works correctly with the new SmartBack hook because navigate(-1) returns to /formations as expected. Recommend product-side clarification before another full retest run.
